lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four discontinuous horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, with the highest concentration of local maxima occurring in the mid-flank area between the fifth gill slit and the first dorsal fin origin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a visible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow-defined ridge line below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are clustered primarily at the base and mid-section of the first dorsal fin silhouette, with spatial density decreasing significantly toward the leading edge and apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable V-shaped indentation or trailing-edge notch located on the posterior margin of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (Echeneidae) visible along the ventral margin and trailing the pectoral fin structure.
